overall_summary: Data clearly shows that complex poetic shayari (e.g., 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा') underperforms significantly, whereas deep emotional family and relationship dynamics (specifically husband-wife and mother themes) massively outperform general emotional content.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about married life like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya' (1770 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1679 views) achieved nearly 6x to 10x more views than average posts.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more narrative-driven content centered on modern marital communication gaps and unspoken expectations.

winning_patterns.evidence: Mother and father emotional shorts ('माँ जब पूछती है...', 'पापा कभी कहते नहीं...') consistently pull stable views (140-250+ range) compared to niche poetry.
winning_patterns.action: Use grounded, everyday household observations instead of abstract philosophy.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos relying heavily on dramatic poetry phrasing like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 21 views.
weak_patterns.action: Abandon high-register, abstract poetry openings and replace them with grounded, visual everyday scenes.

next_video.hook_style: Observation on silent couples in public or at home
next_video.concept: A couple sitting together in complete silence, scrolling phones, realizing they know everything about their digital feeds but nothing about each other's day.
next_video.opening_direction: Start with a quiet visual of two cups of tea getting cold on the table while both partners stare into separate screens.
next_video.twist_direction: The realization that a stranger's reel made them smile today, but their partner's tired face didn't even catch their attention.
next_video.reason: Mid-day posting aligns well with the high-performing relationship and marital content timing observed in top hits like or5gtaBpRVY and my5mP9feI7s.

experiment: Testing if adding a modern digital-age communication contrast to traditional husband-wife relationship themes improves retention further.
